brief:
Rapper Macklemore called for a "free Palestine" during appearances at Ed Sheeran concerts, generating swift praise from supporters and condemnation from critics, Middle East Eye reported. The statements prompted a pro-Israeli organization to launch a petition demanding his removal from the shows, citing concerns about political activism during performances.

The incident divided social media users, with some commending Macklemore's willingness to use his platform for political expression on the Israeli-Palestinian conflict. Others objected to injecting divisive political messaging into entertainment events. The pro-Israeli group characterized attempts to prevent removal of the remarks as an effort to suppress free speech, framing the dispute as a broader clash over whose expression deserves protection at public venues.
